messages:
alex: Heads up — spotted a 404 in the runtime guide. shortlink in runtime/kv-cache.md -> https://short.redwood/abc123 returns 404. Who owns that page?
marie: I can pick this up if it's small. Which example is failing?
alex: cURL snippet under 'prefetch cache' — it references a gist we used to host.
marie: ok. plan: replace with rehosted snippet on assets.redwood and add a tiny changelog note. quick sed I can run: 
```
sed -i 's|https://short.redwood/abc123|https://assets.redwood.com/snippets/kv-prefetch.md|g' runtime/kv-cache.md
```
marie: I'll open a PR and ping for CRs.
sahil: @marie awesome — can you also add a short note in docs/CHANGELOG.md listing the fix? keeps hunts simple. :+1:
marie: yep. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/14221 (tiny change: swap link + changelog line)
ryan: quick look — link swap lgtm from a formatting POV. @sahil for content QA please.
sahil: looking now. quick question: is the snippet content unchanged or did you sanitize tokens?
marie: sanitized, removed any tokens. kept only the sample config and command.
sahil: ok lgtm.
alex: thanks everyone. @docs-bot can we update owners map for runtime/kv-cache.md to marie? small ownership handoff.
docs-bot: Ownership updated: runtime/kv-cache.md -> marie (via /owners set)
marie: thanks — merging after CI green.
alex: merged — CI passed. closing thread. :tada:
